subject.title: test(shared): add unit tests for gateway method policy helpers

question: Should OpenClaw reject previously accepted ElevenLabs `baseUrl` values containing query strings or fragments, or preserve an upgrade-compatible path for existing operator configurations?
rationale: The change is intentional but alters an existing configuration contract; source-level tests cannot determine whether fail-closed validation is the intended upgrade policy for deployed proxy and routing endpoints.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
options.body: Keep existing accepted endpoint configurations working or provide a narrow supported migration path before merging the validation change.

options.title: Approve fail-closed validation
options.body: Accept the new rejection policy only with explicit upgrade documentation and real evidence for both fresh and upgraded configurations.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep existing accepted endpoint configurations working or provide a narrow supported migration path before merging the validation change.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history supplied for this PR shows repeated work on the exact ElevenLabs configuration behavior.
